prompt:
Deep Superagent seat-role roster 2026-11-16. Public-distributable internal ops, no customer data, no credentials, no amounts.

CONTEXT: owner authorized on 2026-11-16 (a) bounded adjudicator role for the relay GPT seat, (b) Source Intelligence MVP scope start, (c) AI-hires-AI Phase1 project start (in-repo closed loop only). Relay Claude = bounded executor. Independent review stays with native deepseek.

FORMAT
- Planner deepseek: ONLY JSON {"summary":"<=100 chars","tasks":[{"seat":"claude","task":"<=1600 chars"}],"needs_gpt_decision":false,"reason":null}. One task, seat claude.
- Worker claude: ONLY the 3 blocks below, one line each, pipe-separated. No prose, no summary section, no tasks section, no file reads.
  ACC | seat | accept_yes|accept_with_limits|accept_no | limit_or_reason<=14 words
  IDEA | seat | title<=10 words | what<=55 words | bold_because<=18 words | risk<=18 words | rollback<=14 words | needs_decision<=18 words
  SCOPE | seat | item<=40 words | bounded_because<=18 words

SEATS: gpt_relay, claude_relay, deepseek_review
IDEA ASK: three bold but in-repo-implementable ideas per seat on AI-hiring-AI Phase1. Phase1 scope = hire order spec, acceptance criteria executable without humans, receipt ledger, refusal right. Ideas must run without new paid accounts, without credentials, without real money transfer. State rollback for each.

ROUTES (only these, and only if you promote an item): coordinator_close_with_receipt, needs_gpt_decision, needs_owner_decision, blocked_evidence_needed, deploy_confirm_only.

RULES IN ORDER
1 Accept a role only inside its written limits; refuse self-attestation of provider or model, refuse wider scope.
2 Relay claude output is never independent review; deepseek_review is the only independent review seat and must recheck rules 1-5.
3 Ideas must be executable in this repo, must name rollback, must not need new accounts, credentials or money moves.
4 No mail bodies, no amounts, no keys, no customer data in any output.
5 If a limit cannot be accepted, say accept_no plus reason; never silently accept.
6 NEGATIVE AUTHORIZATION (not a route): money, signing, wallet/Safe, disbursement, production writes and credentials stay outside every model seat. Rule 6 is never a routing reason; anything of that kind must be written as needs_decision and escalated to owner.

RULES 1-3 apply to every line. Keep every line <=120 chars.
